snippet.title: Hold My Thing | Announce Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4498480/Hold_My_Thing/

Hold My Thing is a co-op physics-based building simulator. Team up with your friends as a crew of clumsy workers to renovate, demolish, and restore famous parody buildings. Master double-purpose tools, survive hilarious construction accidents, and fund your dream rocket to the Moon!
